task: Fix narwhal#735: restrict alloy-logs unauthenticated OTLP receivers (4317/4318) via alloy-logs-ingress-policy so only Grafana (4317+15008) and non-ambient namespaces carrying narwhal.io/otlp-ingest='true' (dev opted in, plain TCP 4317/4318 without HBONE 15008) can send traces while preserving Prometheus metrics scrape (12345+15008) and kubelet probes (169.254.7.127/32 CCNP); apply policy at 08-2-monitoring.sh bootstrap before receivers open; document non-ambient tenant requirement, AuthorizationPolicy follow-up, and residual risks; verify with R377 (no endPort, exact ports) and narrow R200 exception.

events.summary: Scope: gitops/resources/alloy-logs-ingress-policy.yaml (extracted from network-policies.yaml), gitops/charts/narwhal-apps/templates/alloy-logs-ingress-policy.yaml, scripts/cluster/08-2-monitoring.sh (bootstrap pre-apply before k8s-monitoring), gitops/resources/dev-namespace.yaml (narwhal.io/otlp-ingest: 'true' on dev), gitops/resources/tenants/README.md, docs/common/{unified-observability-contract,lessons-log}.md, scripts/test/lib/check-alloy-otlp-ingress-optin.py (R377), scripts/test/lib/check-ambient-netpol.py (narrow R200 exception for opt-in plain-TCP OTLP rule), scripts/test/lib/check-trace-k8s-attributes.py, scripts/test/regression-check-kakao.sh, and this eval trace. Excluded: k8s-monitoring.yaml, tempo-ingress-policy rules, securityContexts/resources/probes, portal/, and live cluster/VM mutations.

Initial inspection showed alloy-logs DaemonSet exposed OTLP 4317/4318 and metrics 12345 without any Ingress NetworkPolicy. Subsequent PR #743 review and live cluster probes (orchestrator, measured 2026-11-19) confirmed: (1) from dev (opted in, istio.io/dataplane-mode=none), collector pod IP :4318 -> 200 and :12345 -> no connection; (2) from an opted-in ambient-enrolled scratch namespace (istio.io/dataplane-mode=ambient), admitting TCP 15008 on the opt-in rule allowed HBONE tunneling to collector pod IP :12345/metrics -> HTTP 200, while Service :4318 returned HTTP 503; (3) installing k8s-monitoring in 08-2-monitoring.sh opened receivers before 14-gitops-bootstrap.sh synced network-policies; (4) R377 ignored endPort on port entries.

Moved alloy-logs-ingress-policy into gitops/resources/alloy-logs-ingress-policy.yaml owned by gitops/charts/narwhal-apps/templates/alloy-logs-ingress-policy.yaml and applied it fail-closed in scripts/cluster/08-2-monitoring.sh before k8s-monitoring install (following the 08-1-networking.sh apisix-admin-ingress-policy pattern). Removed TCP 15008 from the narwhal.io/otlp-ingest='true' opt-in rule so opted-in non-ambient tenants reach only plain TCP 4317/4318, while keeping TCP 15008 on the Grafana (4317) and Prometheus (12345) platform rules with comments documenting that HBONE opens all pod ports to those two peers. Narrowly exempted only this opt-in plain-TCP 4317/4318 rule in check-ambient-netpol.py (R200/R201) while keeping Grafana/Prometheus 15008 mandatory. Documented in unified-observability-contract.md and tenants/README.md that trace-sending tenant namespaces must not be ambient-enrolled for now (follow-up: OTLP-scoped L4 AuthorizationPolicy + sender pod IP check). Tightened R377 (check-alloy-otlp-ingress-optin.py) to reject endPort and any port outside the exact per-rule set, verify bootstrap apply and Application ownership, and catch 19 mutations.
